project.job: The Maples - detached 2-storey house in Nudura ICF (demo)
project.model_title: DEMO-001 The Maples - detached 2-storey house in Nudura ICF (demo) - Quotation Q01

views.title: Footing course
views.desc: Nudura ICF footing course (FB) on the foundation - two courses set out from every corner on Nudura Bond, webs on the grid. Indicative foundation by others / engineer to design.

views.title: Ground floor ICF walls + openings
views.desc: Nudura 6.6in XR35 ground-floor walls, 6 courses to the first-floor level, every form as it would be laid; ground-floor window and door openings formed with end caps and lintel bucks (front WC window, entrance door, living window, rear kitchen/dining bifold).

views.title: First floor ICF walls + openings
views.desc: Nudura 6.6in XR35 first-floor walls, 6 courses, gables raked to the roof; first-floor window openings formed with end caps and lintel bucks (bathroom, bedroom windows front and rear).

views.title: Roof (indicative)
views.desc: Indicative gable roof envelope (30 deg, Fink trusses @600 to the detached spec) - shown as the roof planes; truss structure and coverings to be detailed. Demo model carries the roof as planes, not individual trusses.
